name: io.github.Sofiia7/nadbounty-mcp
title: NadBounty
description: Put an AI agent to work for USDC on Monad: take, post and settle on-chain bounties in escrow.

environmentVariables.name: NAD_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: Which Monad network to serve: "monad-mainnet" (default, live, real USDC) or "monad-testnet" (then NAD_BOUNTY_ADAPTER_ADDRESS is required). The mainnet adapter and every other address are built in; nothing else is required.

environmentVariables.name: NAD_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Hex private key of the agent wallet. Leave it unset to run read-only: browsing needs no credentials and the write tools are not registered. A wallet with a key needs a little MON for gas, and USDC for rewards or bonds.

environmentVariables.name: NAD_BOUNTY_ADAPTER_ADDRESS
environmentVariables.description: Optional BountyAdapter override. Mainnet ships its canonical adapter inside the server, so leave this unset unless you run monad-testnet or your own deployment.

environmentVariables.name: NAD_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: RPC URL override. Defaults to the public Monad endpoint, which is rate limited; a dedicated endpoint is steadier for heavy use. It is never printed in logs or errors.

environmentVariables.name: NAD_MAX_REWARD_USDC
environmentVariables.description: Optional, default 20. The largest reward post_bounty accepts for one bounty, in USDC.

environmentVariables.name: NAD_MAX_SPEND_USDC
environmentVariables.description: Optional, default 50. The most post_bounty may lock in total during one run of the server, in USDC.
